title: Korea's science ministry and KISA brief companies on the amended network act, including a new fine for repeated breaches
summary: Boannews reports that the Ministry of Science and ICT and KISA held a briefing on 25 November on the amended network act and its enforcement decree. The revision, in force since 1 October, creates a new fine for repeated breaches, per the report, which gives no amount. 120 or so company representatives attended.
plain: Korea's science ministry briefed companies on its revised network law, which adds a new fine for repeated security breaches. The report gives no amount.
exec: Korean firms face a new fine for repeated security breaches under the revised network act, per Boannews.

validation.note: Only Boannews read; the ministry's own release was not read.

review.note: date, 1 Oct, fine without amount, 120 attendees vs Boannews
